message.reasoning:
I need to decide whether to sell houses or declare bankruptcy to cover the $750 rent.

Selling all three houses would raise only $75, leaving a $434 shortfall. No properties are mortgageable.

Properties with buildings cannot be mortgaged. I will sell the houses first, then mortgage the light blues for $160 on the next turn. Combined with the $75 from selling, this raises cash by $235.

Even after selling houses and mortgaging the light blues, cash would only reach $476. That is still $274 short of the $750 rent. I should declare bankruptcy now rather than sell houses first.

Standard Monopoly rules require bankrupt players to turn over all assets to the creditor. Selling houses back to the bank at half price would destroy value, so declaring bankruptcy is preferable.
